role: @MainActor XCTest suite for TrendAnalyzer: minimum-session nil, data-point counts and period filtering, RMSSD trend direction (improving/declining/stable), RMSSD statistics, percentiles and CV, rolling baseline, English insights, chart-data extraction, TimePeriod days/names, and exclusion of naps and sessions without results.

units.does: setUp: super.setUp then pinEnglishLanguage so insight copy is English.
units.entry: XCTest runner: async setUp before each test

units.does: Test helper: complete 8 h overnight HRVSession `daysAgo` days before now with a full HRVAnalysisResult (given RMSSD/SDNN/meanHR/DFA α1; ANS metrics only when stressIndex is non-nil) and recoveryScore 7.

branches.effect: nil (never for day offsets) falls back to now
true: attaches ANSMetrics with that stress index; false: ansMetrics nil
